title: Escribe una carta a una tienda en línea sobre el retraso en la entrega de sus cajas
person: A customer manager at a small Spanish carton maker writing to an online shop that orders its shipping boxes there.
review: It answers the online shop's message of 1 October, gives the new delivery date of 30 October with the reason, and offers the 5 per cent discount.
revised_review: The delivery date is 6 November everywhere; 30 October appears nowhere.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
The address sits in the window on the right, inside the zone Correos publishes.
The address is written as Correos reads it: the postcode and the locality in capitals, the province on its own line.
The place and the date are written out in Spanish, with a comma between them.
The salutation ends with a colon and the closing with a comma.
Subject, closing and signatory are in the letter, as its spec names them.
The registered office and the entry in the Registro Mercantil are on the letter.
It gives the new delivery date, the reason (the cutting die arrived late) and the 5 per cent discount on this order.

source: Synthetic material created for this evaluation pack; the companies, people, prices and addresses are invented.
stage_policy: Separate first and revision directories; reveal revision only after first output is frozen.
